text:
anya: Heads-up — sustained queueing on us-west2 GPU pool for the last ~12m. Token burn looks normal but effective TPM served dropped ~40%. 95th latency up from 120ms -> 420ms. Some non-SLA tenants seeing timeouts.

mike: saw that spike in the admission ledger too. Credits look like they were drained by regional fallback traffic after the eu-west blip. Might be burst-credit siphon into us-west.

nico: can you paste the ledger snapshot + token_bank metrics? need refill_rate, outstanding_credits, and per-queue backlog.

anya: putting metrics (sanitized) — note the refill EWMA shape:
```
pool: us-west2-gpu-pool
queue_len: 218
avg_tok_burn_s: 1200
refill_rate_per_s: 800 -> 600 (EWMA 10s)
outstanding_reserved: 0.9k
burst_credits_remaining: 0
per_tenant_throttle: default=1000tpm, sla=3000tpm
```

sre-bot: [ALERT] pool-saturation us-west2 (queue_len>200) — auto-fallback triggered to regional-reserve. ADMISSION: degraded -> prioritizing SLA namespace.

mike: two quick mitigations: 1) scale batcher workers by +2 to reduce per-request queueing, 2) temporarily reduce non-SLA tenant TPM in us-west2 by 25% so reserved bursts go to SLA.

nico: agree. Also we should tweak the token accounting smoothing — EWMA(10s) is letting transient dips blow out refill calculations. Increase smoothing window to 60s for refill_rate and cap refill delta application to 20%/step. Example patch to admission-config: 
```yaml
admission_token_config:
  refill_ewma_window_sec: 60
  max_refill_step_pct: 20
  burst_credit_grace_sec: 45
  regional_fallback_ratio: 0.15
```

sam: note cost hit if we scale permanently. +2 workers ~0.4k USD/day on peak. Keep mitigation temporary and investigate root cause.

anya: executed scaling +2 and applied a staged admission patch (non-SLA -25%). ops-bot will flip a rollback timer at 30m.

ops-bot: action: kubectl scale deploy/gpu-batcher -n inference --replicas=+2 ; patch applied to configmap admission-token-config (v2026-03-18t12:04). Rollback timer set: 30m.

mike: also adding short-term telemetry: emit per-tenant effective_tpm and token_deficit gauge every 5s, so we can see which tenants are absorbing credits.

anya: after scale, queue_len -> 84, 95th latency -> 170ms, effective TPM recovered to ~92% of baseline. Still seeing small oscillations near refill window boundary.

nico: planning: postmortem items — 1) tighten regional fallback policy (reduce siphon), 2) change EWMA window + cap, 3) add a token-levelling pass during long-running heavy batches to avoid smear, 4) run chaos test simulating EU regional outage to verify fallback behaves.

sre-bot: noted — incident ticket created: INC-2026-1143. Priority: P2. Assignees: niko, mike, anya.

sam: re: cost — open a short PO for ephemeral capacity if we need extra replicas during peak tests; track against monthly infra ops budget.

anya: leaving this thread as the runbook for the immediate mitigation. Follow-ups: postmortem doc + config PR for EWMA change. :thumbsup:
